Choose AI InteleKt only if your buying job matches “AI InteleKt is a customer data and retail intelligence platform — unify POS, web, and mobi” rather than n8n's shape. Choose n8n only if your buying job matches “Workflow automation — Community self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo annual (2.5k executio” rather than AI InteleKt's shape.
